title: Constant coefficient tensor data before geometric mates
statement: Fix a prime ell, finite Q_ell-extensions E and F and an algebra map i:E→F [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For each scheme W use the constant ring sheaves and strict module towers of [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations]. Define constantMap by constant sheafification of the actual integral inclusion, tensor as its pointwise sheafified scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and T as exact localization of tensor. Exactness follows from finite freeness of O_F over O_E. Define constants to be this constant ring sheaf with its canonical geometric inverse-image identifications. This is only the constant scalar tensor construction, not the geometric proper/open mate or compact-support comparison.
